scope.children_rusage: OS CPU delta for reaped children, separately reported; do not add to sampled child CPU
scope.cpu: sampled per-process user+system CPU deltas; short-lived processes and final sampling tails may be missed
scope.processes: runner and registered owned service trees; the short-lived format subprocess is not sampled
scope.rss: sampled resident bytes; simultaneous sums double-count shared pages and are not total host memory
scope.runner_cpu: exact process_time delta for benchmark Python, including producer and sampler threads
scope.window: broker format/startup through metadata readiness or failure
